title: The Brew Bus: Austin Brewery Tour with Live Band
includes: Live band on board the bus
Gratuities (recommended) for guide, driver, and band (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 21 years. We ID.
policies: BYOB Bus: beer/wine only, no hard liquor
Coolers gotta be six-pack sized or smaller
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The only tour with a live band on board! Round up your crew and join Austin’s only concert on wheels. Our Twisted bus features a local band riding on board, providing the jams for a good time as we visit THREE local breweries. At each of the breweries, we will serve up local craft brews, included in your tour ticket. Your smart/beautiful/handsome/funny/witty tour guide will also give a little information about the local craft beer scene and the brews on tap.

Your Brew Bus also includes a delicious mid-tour small meal from one of our favorite local food trucks, onsite at the brewery.  

This Austin brewery tour is BYOB, and the perfect pre-drinking party for your weekend night!

If you're interested in a private tour, give us a call at 512-999-TOUR!
